goal: Alert node operators when configured ZMQ sockets fail to bind or initialize instead of failing silently
Abort startup on initialization errors so nodes do not run unaware that notifications are disabled
reviewability: Nothing known that would invalidate a review
agreement: Substantive support with all prior suggestions addressed
Verified by testing abort behavior across various misconfigurations and busy ports (pinheadmz)
Verified by running ZMQ interface tests and manual broken-configuration scenarios (jeanpablojp)

categories.name: rpc
why: P3 because it prevents nodes from silently running without notifications when ZMQ sockets fail to bind
Node operators avoid operating unaware that their requested notification streams are not running
